name: Attorneys registered with the New York courts, by county, status and year of admission (NYS Office of Court Administration)
description: How many lawyers are on New York's official attorney registration list, county by county. For each of the 62 counties the file counts the attorneys whose office address is there by registration status (currently registered, inside the 30-day reregistration window, delinquent, resigned, deceased, disbarred or suspended, incapacitated), by decade of admission to the New York bar, and per 10,000 residents using the Census Bureau's county population estimate. Further records count registrations with an office in each other state or territory, registrations with no office address in the public file, and the four judicial departments of admission, and the state record carries the admission-year history. Only counts are published: no name, address, phone number, firm or registration number is read, because the pull asks the court's open data portal for server-side totals and never downloads rows. Counts in a disciplinary status or an admission decade are published from five up. Every record adds up to the state, the state ties to the source's own row count, and the American Bar Association's 2025 count of New York resident active lawyers sits between the two bounds the file allows.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Attorneys registered with the New York courts, by county, status and year of admission (NYS Office of Court Administration) (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116050
keywords: number of lawyers in New York
New York bar admissions by decade

distribution.name: ny-attorneys.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: ny-attorneys.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: ny-attorneys-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in ny-attorneys-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to ny-attorneys.csv on id.

recordSet.name: ny-attorneys
recordSet.description: The records of Attorneys registered with the New York courts, by county, status and year of admission (NYS Office of Court Administration), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: NY: every record is a New York registration

field.name: level
field.description: county (office address in that New York county), county-not-given (an office in New York with no county in the file), address-outside-ny (one per state, territory or military code of an office outside New York), address-not-published (no office address in the public file), department (judicial department of admission) or state (all registrations)

field.name: stateName
field.description: New York

field.name: year
field.description: Year the court file was last updated

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Attorneys currently registered in the record's group

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: registered
field.description: Registration status Currently registered

field.name: due_to_reregister
field.description: Status Due to reregister within 30 days of birthday: still registered, in the window to renew

field.name: active
field.description: Currently registered plus those in the 30-day reregistration window

field.name: delinquent
field.description: Status Delinquent: registration lapsed

field.name: resigned
field.description: Status Resigned (not for disciplinary reasons)

field.name: deceased
field.description: Status Deceased

field.name: incapacitated
field.description: Status Incapacitated; published from 5 up

field.name: total
field.description: All registrations in the record's group, any status

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
